description.value: At 4th level, a geomancer has learned to access her favored terrain, wherever she may be. Once per day, as a swift action, she may treat the area within a 30-ft radius burst centered on her as one of her favored terrain (chosen upon activation). This ability lasts for 1 round per geomancer level. She gains an additional use of this ability at 8th, 12th, 16th and 20th level. At 8th level, the radius increases by 10 ft. At 12th level, the radius increases by another 10 ft, and the duration becomes minutes per geomancer level. At 16th level, the radius increases by another 10 ft. At 20th level, the duration becomes 10 minutes per geomancer level.
